''See also: [[Olissa Agnos Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Olissa [[Agnos]] is a skilled craftswoman and the matriarch of the [[Agnos family]], which includes her husband Caius Agnos{{!}}Caius, daughter Andra Agnos{{!}}Andra, and children [[Lycus]] and Caius Agnos{{!}}Caius. She is characterized by her auburn hair—which she has previously cut short—and a tendency to wear protective goggles and work gloves. Often covered in soot or grease from her labor, she operates a Workshop{{!}}workshop where she works with various tools and materials to create specialized items. Olissa possesses significant technical knowledge regarding the artifacts of a [[Territory]] and the nature of [[Valinhall]]'s energy. She has dedicated herself to studying how to harness this power, specifically through the creation of masks that can access [[Valinhall]]'s energy once a guardian has been defeated. Her work involves analyzing prototypes and attempting to recreate complex devices, such as masks that draw power from the environment. Throughout her experiences, she has demonstrated a protective nature toward her family and an ability to interact with powerful figures, including [[Travelers]] and the [[Eldest]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Olissa has short, honey-brown hair. She is seen wearing copper goggles and work gloves.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|As a tinkerer, she works in a Workshop{{!}}workshop and is currently developing new versions of [[Simon's mask]]. She takes an active role in caretaking, such as checking on [[Simon]] and ordering him to use the [[healing pool]].}}
